arrive.text: The Festival of Summer, in the city of Omelas.

happy.text: Everyone here is happy. Not foolishly, and not because they're told to be. They just are.

knows.text: Everyone in Omelas knows about the door at the foot of the hall.

not_yet.text: The festival has only just begun.

flute.text: A boy plays the flute, alone, for anyone who stops to listen.

horses.text: The horses have ribbons braided into their manes. They know it's a race day.

cellar.text: Under one of the beautiful buildings, in the dark, a child sits alone.

terms.text: The city's happiness, all of it, depends on this child staying here, in the dark.

terms_2.text: If it were brought up into the sunlight, and comforted, all of it would be lost. Those are the terms.

ask.text: Now you know too. What will you do?

back_up.text: You come back up into the sunlight. The music is still playing.

stay_idle.text: The music plays on. You stay.

stay_2.text: Most people who see the child are shocked. In time, most of them come to accept it.

walk_1.text: You walk out of Omelas, alone, towards the mountains.

walk_2.text: Nobody knows where they go, the ones who walk away. They seem to be sure of the way.

free_1.text: You carry the child up, into the sun.

free_2.text: And the music stops. The colour goes out of everything. Those were the terms.

free_3.text: One child is warm. And the rest of Omelas is not.
